verdict.rationale: Close documents a broad first-party REST API: leads, contacts, activities, opportunities, custom objects and fields, bulk actions, sequences, email/SMS sending, reporting, the event log, webhooks and forms. It also publishes an OpenAPI spec and an MCP server with write and delete scopes. However, nothing states or demonstrates full UI-to-API parity. missing for 10: an explicit parity claim or coverage audit, evidence of API control over the Chloe AI agent, the dialer and calling, workflow configuration, and roles/permissions and settings, plus independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Push leads, contacts, activities, and custom data into Close from your website or other systems via the REST API.
Manage workflows with sequences or bulk actions, or send email/SMS programmatically.
mcp.write_destructive — can read, write, and delete data
